1. Infection triggers the immune system to recognize the pathogen
2. The body produces specific antibodies to neutralize the virus or bacteria
3. These antibodies block the virus from entering healthy cells
4. The body creates memory cells to recognize the pathogen later
5. This immunity provides protection against future infections
6. Vaccines use weakened pathogens to stimulate this natural defense
